items.title: Footer "Shop all" link's accessible name is "Shop all products"
covers: Expected: The link's accessible name is "Shop all products"
items.reason: This is the bug itself: screen readers must announce the link as "Shop all products". The rendered accessibility tree is the only place the computed name is observable, so the case runs on the e2e layer through the WebApp. That the old name "Shop all" is gone is a separate sad case (TC-PRB-9-04).

items.title: Footer "Shop all" link's visible text is unchanged
covers: Expected: Its visible text ("Shop all") is unchanged
items.reason: The story requires the fix to change only what is announced, not what sighted and voice-control users see; a fix that replaced the visible text would break that. It is a separate case from the accessible name because the two are independent properties (aria-label overrides the name without touching the text). Only the rendered page shows the visible text, so e2e.

items.title: Footer "Shop all" link still opens the catalog
covers: Expected: its destination (the catalog) is unchanged
items.reason: The story requires the link's destination to stay the catalog (the WebApp's root page `/`). Starting from a different page proves the click actually navigates to the catalog rather than merely staying on it. Navigation is only observable in the browser, so e2e.

items.title: No footer Shop link is announced with the bare name "Shop all"
covers: Actual: The accessible name is "Shop all" (must no longer hold)
Acceptance Criteria: the result matches Expected
items.reason: The bug's **Actual** is the failure state the fix must eliminate: a link announced only as "Shop all". The boundary is the exact name: the visible text "Shop all" is still rendered, so a fix that left the accessible name equal to the visible text (for example an `aria-label` on the wrong element, or a `title` that does not override the name) would still look fixed to a sighted tester. Checking that the exact old name resolves to nothing proves the computed name moved past the visible text. Only the rendered accessibility tree shows the computed name, so e2e.
